clue.text: Air filter

definitions.meaning: an air is a tune or melody
to filter liquid is to pass it through a sieve or cloth

explanation.definitionFit: A strain is a passage of melody, an air; and to strain a liquid is to sieve or filter it.

clue.text: Wine, a pound over in top inn in resort, and clubs

indicators.note: the first 'in' puts the reversed pair inside the rearranged letters that follow
'in resort' means having recourse to rearrangement, so the letters of top inn are reordered
'over' tells us the pair a and pound is turned back to front

parts.note: LB is the abbreviation for a pound in weight
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A wine list entry describing a drinker at a resort hotel, paying a pound extra, with golf clubs to hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in resort' rearranges TOP INN into PINOTN; 'over' turns A LB into BLA, and 'in' sets that inside to give PINOTBLAN, before C is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinot blanc is a white grape variety and the dry white wine made from it.

clue.text: Likewise a leading orchestra

parts.note: LSO is the London Symphony Orchestra, one of the leading orchestras

explanation.surface: A review saying another ensemble is likewise one of the top orchestras.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are adverbs meaning in addition or in the same way, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Photograph game attempt

parts.note: snap is a children's card game where matching cards are called out
a shot is an attempt, as in having a shot at something

explanation.surface: A caption: a picture taken of someone's attempt during a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot is an informal photograph taken quickly, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Make out detailed object and obsolete coin

indicators.note: de-tailed: the word for make out loses its tail, its final letter

parts.note: to fare is to make out or get on, as in how did you fare
a thing is an object

explanation.surface: A collector discerning a detailed object which turns out to be an old coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like a description of the object but means cut off the tail of FARE, leaving FAR.
explanation.definitionFit: The farthing was a British coin worth a quarter of an old penny, withdrawn in 1961, hence obsolete.

clue.text: Lodged in a river in state capital

indicators.note: the first 'in' places the word for lodged inside the river's letters

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and also one on the England–Wales border
laid means put down or lodged, as in laid to rest

explanation.surface: Something stuck in a river in an Australian state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelaide is the capital city of the state of South Australia.

clue.text: Suitable for gourmets, grill's opening — tremendous

indicators.note: the opening of the word grill's is its first letter

parts.note: astronomical means enormous or tremendous, as in astronomical prices

explanation.surface: A restaurant review: the grill's opening night was tremendous and fit for gourmets.
explanation.definitionFit: Gastronomical relates to fine eating and good food, so it describes what suits gourmets.

clue.text: In need of companionship working in large cathedral city

indicators.note: the second 'in' places the word for working inside large plus the city

parts.note: L is the standard clothing-size abbreviation for large
Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
on means working or operating, as a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: Someone working in a big cathedral city and feeling isolated.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lonely is solitary and longs for company, exactly what needing companionship describes.

clue.text: Play set in Waterloo, two-hander

indicators.note: set in says the answer is lodged within the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A theatre listing: a play for two actors set in Waterloo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two-hander' looks like a description of the play but just provides letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Loot is a 1965 black comedy stage play by Joe Orton.

clue.text: Some stopped alongside pleasure craft

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some boats pulled up alongside a pleasure craft.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedalo is a small pedal-powered boat hired for fun at the seaside or on a lake.

clue.text: Stinging creature in house close to firescreen

parts.note: Scorpio is one of the twelve zodiac signs, called houses in astrology

indicators.note: the close of the word firescreen is its final letter

explanation.surface: An insect lurking in a house near the firescreen.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorpion is an arachnid with a venomous sting in its curved tail.

clue.text: Artist captures gold in part of tree

parts.note: gains means captures or wins, as in an army gains ground

indicators.note: 'in' puts the heraldic gold inside the part of the tree

parts.note: a bough is a main branch of a tree
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: An artist painting gold light in the branches of a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'captures' looks like the containment signal, but it is GAINS, a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Gainsborough was an 18th-century English painter of portraits and landscapes.

clue.text: Wave from worried adult in agreement

indicators.note: 'in' puts the rearranged letters inside the word for agreement

parts.note: a union is an agreement or alliance

indicators.note: worried letters are disturbed and churned up into a new order

explanation.surface: A wave from an anxious grown-up who nonetheless agrees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wave' could be a greeting, but here it names a rippling shape; 'worried' looks like the adult's mood.
explanation.definitionFit: An undulation is a wavelike rise and fall, so it is a wave in form.

clue.text: Stood up on pitch getting trophy?

indicators.note: in a down entry 'on' puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: rose means got up or stood up
to bowl is to pitch the ball, as in cricket

explanation.surface: A player rising to their feet on the field to collect a cup.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the answer is a type of trophy, not a definition of all trophies.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose bowl is a decorative silver bowl often awarded as a prize in competitions.

clue.text: Heart-throb, not working it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals the spoken sound of the word for not working

parts.note: idle means not working, inactive

explanation.surface: Gossip that a pin-up hasn't been working lately.
explanation.definitionFit: A heart-throb is a much adored celebrity, the object of fans' worship, as is a pop idol.

clue.text: Miss holiday abroad

parts.note: leave is time off work, a holiday
out means away from home, abroad

explanation.surface: Missing a holiday overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave out is to omit, which is to miss something out.

clue.text: Bearded dean upset about wife

indicators.note: about means going round, so the rearranged letters surround the wife abbreviation
upset letters are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A bearded church dean upset over his wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges DEAN into ANED, and 'about' puts it round W.
explanation.definitionFit: Awned is a botanical term for grasses with bristles, such as bearded barley.

clue.text: Implement of inordinate length

parts.note: too means excessively, inordinately, as in too long

explanation.surface: An instrument of excessive length.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is an implement used for doing work by hand.

clue.text: Professional pulled it off

definitions.meaning: as an adjective meaning skilled and expert, of professional standard
a past-tense verb meaning succeeded in doing or completed it

explanation.surface: Praise for an expert who succeeded.
explanation.definitionFit: Accomplished as an adjective means expert, and as a past verb means achieved or carried out.

clue.text: Small insignificant snub

explanation.definitionFit: Slight means slender, means trivial, and as a noun means an insult or cold-shouldering.

clue.text: Chess piece in hand, knight

parts.note: a paw is a slang word for a hand
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A player holding a chess piece in their hand, perhaps a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knight' tempts as the chess piece itself; it only gives N.
explanation.definitionFit: The pawn is the lowest-ranked chess piece, eight per side.

clue.text: Sublime joke grasped by the old lady in charge

indicators.note: grasped by means held inside the following letters

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother, the old lady
a jest is a joke

explanation.surface: A mother in charge getting a joke, finding it sublime.
explanation.definitionFit: Majestic means grand and awe-inspiring, which is what sublime means.

clue.text: Fish aunt cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters have been fiddled into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A dish of fish one's aunt cooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuna is a large oceanic food fish, such as albacore or bluefin.

clue.text: Stand when tour party brought over

parts.note: a trip is a journey, a tour

indicators.note: brought over means turned back to front

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A camera support brought along on a tour by a group.
explanation.definitionFit: A tripod is a three-legged stand, used for cameras.

clue.text: Elected to go off one after the other

parts.note: in means elected to office, as a candidate who gets in
to turn is to go off or sour, as milk turns

explanation.surface: Elected representatives going off one by one.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in sequence, one after another.

clue.text: Syndicate rejected flaw as way out of contract?

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: a pool is a syndicate sharing resources or bets
a hole is a flaw, as a hole in an argument

explanation.surface: A syndicate turning down a contract as flawed and looking for a way out.
explanation.definitionFit: A loophole is an ambiguity or omission in a contract or law that lets one evade it.
